display.title: Display
display.description: Choose the language and number style for this device.
display.languageHint: The language of the app's screens.
display.digitsHint: Phone numbers, card codes and receipt numbers always use Western digits.
display.previewHint: Numbers and dates will look like this.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: The gym's color, corners and logo, and your own look.

gym.title: Gym look
gym.description: For every device of this gym. What you change here changes for all staff.
gym.readOnly: Only staff who can change settings and have access to all branches can change the gym's look.

brand.label: Brand color
brand.hint: For buttons, the selected item and field borders. Green, amber and red are kept for status and never change.

contrast.title: This color is hard to read
contrast.brand_as_text: Text in this color on the page ({{mode}} theme).
contrast.brand_as_icon: Icons and lines in this color ({{mode}} theme).

appearance.statusLike: This color looks like a status color (green: allowed, amber: warning, red: denied). Staff may mix them up.

corner.label: Corner style
corner.hint: The corners of cards, buttons and fields.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Resized to {{side}} pixels and at most {{size}} KB. Shown at the top of the app and on the login screen.
logo.none: No logo: the gym's name is shown instead.
logo.confirmDescription: It shows on every device of the gym. Size: {{size}} KB.
logo.removeDescription: The gym's name is shown instead of the logo.

errors.logo_type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP pictures.
errors.logo_unreadable: This picture can't be read. Choose another one.
errors.logo_too_large: The picture is too large, even after resizing. Choose a simpler one.

appearance.needsConnection: Saving needs a connection to the server.

confirm.title: Save this color?
confirm.description: There are these problems. You can choose another color, or save it anyway.

personal.title: My look
personal.description: Just for you, on every device. The lock screen keeps the look of the last staff member.
personal.themeHint: Light, dark, or the same as the device.
personal.textSizeHint: Large: text, spacing and buttons grow together.
